The book of revelation was written by John AFTER the destruction of the temple. Yet what is commonly misunderstood about the book of revelation is it's specific genre. It is a part of Jewish Apocalyptic Literature, specifically Literature of the Oppressed. Literature of the Oppressed means that it is written in direct rebellion to the current powers who are oppressing them. An author cannot write directly what he wants because if found it could lead to his death. Instead he encrypts his story within obscure language so as to mask his true agenda to anyone who doesn't already know what the author is trying to say. To most Millennialists this period of 70 Weeks, or 490 years, is broken into two parts: a period of 483 years, which concluded with the crucifixion of Jesus Christ in A.D. 33; and one, final seven-year period that leads up to Armageddon.
